Exercise 2 Questions 33-40 This final comprehension exercise was, as intended, the most demanding part of the paper and many candidates found it quite challenging. Most could clearly access the general meaning of the text and generally understood the questions, though some candidates were not always sure of the meanings of common question words ( quel, comment, qu’est-ce que etc.). Many were able to locate the correct part of the text relevant to the question, but they were often not selective enough in formulating an answer. Some were unable to manipulate their answer sufficiently to give an acceptable response. In this exercise, candidates need to be able to make the necessary changes between direct and reported speech and to deal with the resulting pronoun / possessive adjective confusion. Most candidates were able to score on Question 33 , though some answers were invalidated by the candidates’ inappropriate ‘lifting’ of the whole of the first sentence of the text. Question 34 caused few difficulties for candidates. A lot of candidates managed to score at least 1 mark for Question 35(i) and (ii) even when they had found other questions in this exercise difficult. Question 36 was generally well answered. Although, on the face of it, Question 37 seemed straightforward (requiring an answer along the lines of dans/avec un sac à dos) , candidates often invalidated their answers with inappropriate additions (e.g. reference to the contents of the rucksack) or by not selecting from the text carefully enough (e.g. d’ un sac à dos).
